evidence.quote: Freight Management System — Microservices

source_text: Freight Management System — Microservices

value: Implemented gRPC-based inter-service communication and a Kafka-driven event system for real-time parcel tracking. Built event deduplication logic and used Cadence workflow orchestration for retrying and reprocessing failed events. Generated freight bills and shipping labels via ZPL, and implemented fuel-price and carrier-discount business rules. Used PostgreSQL for transactional data and Cassandra for high-volume tracking events; managed schema migrations. Applied dependency injection (samber/do) to reduce coupling; wrote unit/integration tests using a TDD approach.
